Interface AccessUnitVisitor

public interface AccessUnitVisitor
Visitor protocol invoked by DatasetWalker for every transport-stream event a filtered dataset produces. All methods have empty default implementations — concrete visitors override only the events they care about.

Event order:

  1. visitStreamHeader(DatasetWalker, String, String, String, List, int) once.
  2. visitDatasetHeader(DatasetWalker, int, String, int, String, List, String, int) per matched dataset.
  3. visitAccessUnit(DatasetWalker, AccessUnit, int, int) per matched AU.
  4. visitEndOfDataset(DatasetWalker, int, int) per matched dataset.
  5. visitEndOfStream(DatasetWalker) once.

Cross-language equivalents:

  • Objective-C: TTIOTransportEventVisitor
  • Python: ttio.transport.walker.WalkerEvent (variant types yielded by walk_dataset)
